mapper.select: SELECT target_category AS targetCategory, target_id AS targetId, binding_key AS bindingKey, formula_id AS formulaId, override_params::text AS overrideParamsJson FROM public.formula_bindings WHERE game_id = #{gameId} ORDER BY target_category, target_id, binding_key

SELECT target_category AS targetCategory, target_id AS targetId, binding_key AS bindingKey, formula_id AS formulaId, override_params::text AS overrideParamsJson FROM public.formula_bindings WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND updated_at > #{updatedAfter} ORDER BY target_category, target_id, binding_key
mapper.update: INSERT INTO public.formula_bindings (game_id, target_category, target_id, binding_key, start_version_id, end_version_id, formula_id, override_params, updated_at) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{targetCategory}, #{targetId}, #{bindingKey}, #{versionId}, #{versionId}, #{formulaId}, CAST(#{overrideParamsJson} AS jsonb), NOW()) ON CONFLICT (game_id, target_category, target_id, binding_key) DO UPDATE SET start_version_id = EXCLUDED.start_version_id, end_version_id = EXCLUDED.end_version_id, formula_id = EXCLUDED.formula_id, override_params = EXCLUDED.override_params, updated_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO public.formula_bindings_log (game_id, target_category, target_id, binding_key, start_version_id, end_version_id, formula_id, override_params) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{targetCategory}, #{targetId}, #{bindingKey}, #{versionId}, #{versionId}, #{formulaId}, CAST(#{overrideParamsJson} AS jsonb)) ON CONFLICT (game_id, target_category, target_id, binding_key, start_version_id) DO UPDATE SET end_version_id = EXCLUDED.end_version_id, formula_id = EXCLUDED.formula_id, override_params = EXCLUDED.override_params
